metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – RTT Spine Examples (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: Canonical RTT Progression, Examples, and Forbidden Transitions
metadata.description: Defines RTT progression examples, semantic meanings, and constraint demonstrations for FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: RTT spine examples are projections only; authoritative values come from RTT v0.9, regimes.json, operators.json, substrate.json, and spec‑008.

RTT1.meaning: Initial spread of signal across the triadic field.
RTT1.example: System begins with stable diffusion under measure.c1 >= 0.80.

RTT2.meaning: Signal alignment across the triadic axes.
RTT2.example: Aligned axes allow coupling to proceed without paradox.

RTT3.meaning: Binding of aligned axes into coherent triadic structure.

RTT4.meaning: Activation of triadic structure for higher-order processing.
RTT4.example: Activation prepares the system for triadic-time expansion.

RTT6.meaning: Signal-to-noise evaluation of the triadic field.

RTT7.meaning: Entry into harmonic regime via typed paradox.
RTT7.example: Typed paradox event detected; paradox density >= 0.10.

RTT8.meaning: Stabilization of paradox within harmonic lattice.

RTT10.example: Measures c1 and c2 >= 0.80; consent = true.

RTT11.meaning: Alignment of triadic structure for collapse.

RTT12.meaning: Canonical collapse returning system to RTT1.
RTT12.example: Collapse triggers lineage increment and resets to RTT1.

canonical_progression: RTT1 → RTT2 → RTT3 → RTT4 → RTT5 → RTT6 → RTT7 → RTT8 → RTT9 → RTT10 → RTT11 → RTT12 → RTT1
non_claims: RTT spine examples do not revise RTT v0.9.
RTT spine examples do not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
RTT spine examples do not replace the human FFT book.
